release_notes:
UC PACS now checks its licence key with us when it is set up, and won't finish setup with a key we don't recognise.

It now signs you out properly when the computer is left sitting idle. Before, it warned you that it would and then stayed open.

Pulling the text out of a scanned report works again.

Your clinic name can now be filled in automatically on scans that arrive without one. Turn it on under Settings, System, Clinic Defaults.

The download is around half the size it used to be.
